title: Smart Home Agents Make Capable but Unpredictable Grid Operators
summary: In simulated Home Assistant outage runs, LLM agents showed model- and warning-time-dependent recovery; qwen3.8-27b fixed 94% of faulted devices in the reported test setting, and trace analysis identified recurring failure modes. This is a bounded smart-home resilience result, not evidence of real-home or utility deployment.
